platform.title: What EliteEW is
platform.subtitle: Empery World's work environment: sign in through the browser and open the programs you need like on your own computer.
paragraphs: EliteEW started in May 2025 as Empery World's main project. The idea was simple: create our own place where the team does not jump between dozens of unrelated windows.
Inside it are the desktop, program store, marketing hall, GAF, documents, presentations, music, images, KIRS sites, EWDesk, EWA, Android, VR, and AR.
The point is not the number of features. The point is the connection: a thought becomes a task, a task becomes a material, and a material becomes a published result or a team decision.

philosophy.title: The idea behind Empery World
philosophy.subtitle: A strong environment does not pressure people. It keeps the useful things close enough to act.
philosophy.quote: EliteEW is not here for noise or a shiny showcase. It is here so the team can understand the task, see the next step, and finish the work.
paragraphs: Empery World builds EliteEW as its own work environment. That is why the project values connection over noise: where the task is, who owns it, what materials are ready, and what comes next.
EWA and AMKA are not decorative names. EWA helps on the desktop and in everyday work; AMKA guides marketing step by step.

faq.title: Brief and clear
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions people usually ask first

items.q: Are Empery World and EliteEW the same thing?
items.a: No. Empery World is the company. EliteEW is its main project. Project authorship: po&T and TZBrand.
In the browser at app.eliteew.ru, on Android, and in VR and AR. One project, opened on different screens.

items.q: What do VR and AR mean in EliteEW?
items.a: The same EliteEW on a large screen. You open the desktop, calls, materials, and programs in virtual or augmented reality.
EWA helps with everyday desktop work. AMKA helps inside the marketing hall. Different companions for different jobs.
No. EliteEW is created inside Empery World. The desktop, programs, companions, and work links are made for the team's tasks.
Open app.eliteew.ru and sign in with your organization account. After sign-in, you will see the desktop and the programs available to you.

items.q: Where can I get help with the interface?
items.a: On the desktop, open Assistant (product help). If you need help from the team or have an idea, use Feedback.

items.q: How is EWA different from AMKA?
items.a: EWA helps beside the desktop: conversation, actions, music, images, and hints. AMKA works inside marketing: research, campaigns, and step-by-step reviews.

items.q: How do I sign in to EliteEW?
items.a: Open app.eliteew.ru and sign in with your organization account. The set of programs depends on your role and access settings.
